description: This file defines CRUD API endpoints for managing guardrails in a FastAPI application, including listing, creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving detailed info about guardrails, as well as UI configuration endpoints and validation functions.

classes.name: CreateGuardrailRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a new guardrail

classes.name: UpdateGuardrailRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating an existing guardrail

methods.name: _get_guardrails_list_response
methods.description: Helper to generate list response of guardrails from config list

methods.name: list_guardrails
methods.description: Endpoint to list guardrails available on the proxy server from config

methods.name: list_guardrails_v2
methods.description: Endpoint to list guardrails from database and in-memory cache

methods.name: create_guardrail
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new guardrail and initialize it in memory

methods.name: update_guardrail
methods.description: Endpoint to update an existing guardrail and sync in memory

methods.name: delete_guardrail
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a guardrail from database and memory

methods.name: patch_guardrail
methods.description: Endpoint to partially update a guardrail's fields

methods.name: get_guardrail_info
methods.description: Retrieve detailed info about a specific guardrail by ID

methods.name: get_guardrail_ui_settings
methods.description: Get UI configuration for guardrails, including supported entities, modes, and categories

methods.name: get_category_yaml
methods.description: Fetch YAML content for a specific content filter category

methods.name: validate_blocked_words_file
methods.description: Validate the syntax and structure of a blocked words YAML file

methods.name: get_provider_specific_params
methods.description: Retrieve provider-specific parameters for guardrail configuration

methods.name: apply_guardrail
methods.description: Test applying a guardrail to input text and get processed output
